mu_name_from: aida's object slot: type N is Object{N+1}.bmd, from Data/Object34.

material_note: aidalightflower: green ribbed stems painted on black, a JPEG MU draws opaque (no .OZT ships), its UVs on the green strips: foliage. flowerlight2_R: flat salmon in MU, drawn here from a deep red copy; the bulbs' own glow, added.
why_this_one: The red light-flower: the same drooping stems with salmon-red bulbs, 28 of them, its 13-key sway. Light-flower batch (the user, 2026-10-11: 'continou'). docs/worlds/aida-port.md.
additive_from: An _R sheet: MU's TextureScript makes it the blend mesh (TextureScript.cpp:16-58, ZzzBMD.cpp:2236-2242), as Tarkan's chogatea02_R.
emitters_from: MoveAidaObject type 71 (GMAida.cpp:65-71): AddTerrainLight (0.9, 0.2, 0.2) plus rand() % 5 * 0.01, radius 2 tiles. Carried as a lamp in that red at 1.0-1.04, picking a new level 12.5 times a second, eased over 0.04 s. Raised half a metre off the flower's foot so it lights the ground round it and the figures by it.
effects_note: RenderAidaObjectVisual (GMAida.cpp:106-150, 253-297): six BITMAP_SPARK+1 pairs at bones 6, 7, 8, 12, 13 and 17, drawn by Ornaments' Aida arm (game/world/ornaments.cpp).
glow_from: Ours (the user, 2026-10-11: 'flowers could look better'): the bulb mesh at 0.35 of its glow. Added at full under Aida's glow_strength 1.3 over the spark's white heart, the flat sheet clipped to white and its facets stood as hard chips; at 0.35 it keeps its colour and the spark's halo carries the light (game/world/ornaments.cpp kAidaGlows).
